proposals.evidence: Full śūla explicitly gives Punjabi sūl spike/thorn/colic, supporting Kaithal sulə thorn through its direct regional thorn sense. Source final vowel remains intact; local inflection and transmission are qualified. This is not a meaning inferred only from the Sanskrit impaling-stake gloss. Exact response: sulə.
